title.narrative: Capacity Building for the Philippines' Public-Private Partnership Center

description.narrative: This activity aims to assist the PPP Center in building up its capacity to enable it to play a key role in the country's PPP program, which has been proclaimed as a centerpiece strategy for infrastructure development by the new government. By virtue of Executive Order No. 8, the former BOT Center was renamed as the PPP Center and transferred to the National Economic and Development Authority (NEDA) from the Department of Trade and Industry. The PPP Center was given a range of powers and functions that include: providing policy recommendations, project preparation and development, monitoring of the PPP program, and project facilitation and assistance to implementing agencies, including management of the Project Development and Monitoring Fund. Proposed IDF Components/Activities (including Expected Outcome for each Component) are as follows 1. Internal strategic planning workshops on the vision, priority activities, and institutional setup for PPP Center to affirm the agency's role in the country's PPP program 2. Consultations with oversight agencies and potential client agencies on the PPP Center's medium-term strategic action plan 3. On-the-job training for PPP on project development and preparation with respect to 1-2 specific PPP projects Key Monitoring Indators are as follows: 1. Adoption of Medium-Term Strategic Action Plan of the PPP Center 2. Completion of Operational Manuals and Training Manuals for specific functions of the PPP center 3. 1-2 PPP projects of selected implementing agencies provided assistance by the PPP center in project development and preparation The technical assistance (TA) is intended to strengthen the PPP Center's institutional capacity to pursue its mandate to provide technical assistance to agencies/LGUs in PPP project preparation and development in line with its updated medium term action plan and strategies. Subsequently, the PPP Center is expected to be more equipped to provide the necessary technical leadership and assistance to implementing agencies and local government units in fast-tracking their development, structuring and implementation of priority infrastructure projects that will ultimately realize the government's development agenda through PPPs.
